policy: Prior two observed disturbances repeated as two-step forecast; frozen before current observation. Compare max, half, zero release; objective 4 times sum of forecast residuals plus terminal unused-storage deficit; second transition greedy. Ties prefer greater release.
limitations: Two model ticks not physical seconds; candidate search and reserve weight provisional. No future input supplied to planner. Forecasts may be wrong; no claim of uniform improvement. Symbolic lossless storage, separate from payload.
